content.text: {"grade": 7, "complete": true, "main_gap": "none", "errors": [{"description": "Liu's marks are misstated: with consecutive interval lengths δ,2δ,…,2^nδ the marks are at (2^j−1)δ, not 2^jδ (marks at 2^jδ would give intervals 2δ,2δ,… with Γ=0). The construction is unambiguously defined by the stated lengths, and only the lengths are used, so this is an inconsequential slip.", "quote": "Thus his marks are \\(2^j\\delta\\) for \\(1\\le j\\le n\\), all distinct and strictly inside the stick."}], "notes": "Drafting lemma (value = alternating sum, verified by direct cancellation), refinement lemma (tree-component bipartition for the lower bound; overlay construction with cut count ≤ q−1 for the upper bound), pigeonhole on 2^{n+1} subset sums, and the binary construction are all correct and fit together. Sections 5–6 are extraneous but harmless."}
